This release moves the MCP server to SDK v2 with live progress and cancellation, makes `--compress` output far more accurate, and brings a big round of bug fixes from first-time contributors!

## What's New 🚀

### MCP Server on SDK v2 and the 2026-07-28 Protocol (#1952, #1954)

The MCP server now runs on the MCP TypeScript SDK v2. Clients that support the 2026-07-28 protocol negotiate it automatically, and existing clients work as before.

- The server exits cleanly when the client closes stdin, so no `repomix --mcp` processes are left behind.
- The install pulls in about half as many packages (171 to 84), since the v1 SDK brought HTTP transport dependencies such as Express that the stdio-only server never used.

For client authors: tool schemas now declare JSON Schema 2020-12 (bodies unchanged), and validation errors no longer start with `MCP error -32602: `.

### MCP: Progress and Cancellation for Long-Running Packs (#1955, #1958)

`pack_codebase`, `pack_remote_repository` and `generate_skill` now send `notifications/progress` when the client passes a `progressToken`, so long packs show live status, and clients that reset their timeout on progress no longer cut them off. In `--sandbox` mode, messages carry only the stage name, never a host path.

Cancelling a call or disconnecting now stops the pack and cleans up its partial output.

## Improvements ⚡

### More Accurate `--compress` Output (#2003)

Golden tests for every supported language exposed a set of bugs, now fixed:

- Code from function bodies no longer leaks into the output as if it were a declaration.
- Duplicate lines are removed.
- Declarations that were silently dropped are kept, such as C/C++ `typedef` and `#define`, C# and Java fields, Rust struct fields, Ruby `attr_*` calls and CSS at-rules.

Output changes for C, C++, C#, CSS, Dart, Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Ruby, Rust, Swift and Vue. If you rely on `--compress` in a pipeline, expect a diff from v1.18.

### Skill Generation: Better Tech-Stack Detection (#1995)

`--skill-generate` now reads dependencies from Gradle Kotlin DSL (`build.gradle.kts`) and from the PEP 621 and Poetry forms of `pyproject.toml`.

### Warning When a Remote URL Path Is Ignored (#1980, #1984, #433)

A URL like `https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/src/shared` packed the whole repository and silently dropped the path. Repomix now warns and suggests an `--include` pattern:

```
The path "src/shared" in the remote URL is ignored, and the whole repository will be packed.
To pack only that path, add: --include "src/shared/**"
```

## Bug Fixes 🐛

### Ignore Patterns Ending in a Wildcard Now Exclude Files (#1963, #1876, #320)

Patterns such as `**/npm-debug.log*` and `**/repomix-output.*` only excluded directory contents, so files like `npm-debug.log.1` and `docs/repomix-output.xml` slipped into the output. They are now excluded. Nothing that was excluded before becomes included.

### `.git/info/exclude` Follows Git's Matching Rules (#1871, #1870)

A slash-free pattern such as `secret.txt` now matches at any depth, as in Git, so `sub/secret.txt` is no longer packed.

Special thanks to @sxh313 for this contribution! 🎉

### Negated Custom Ignore Patterns No Longer Invert (#1975, #400)

`!main.ts` in `ignore.customPatterns` or `--ignore` excluded `main.ts` instead of re-including it. Negated patterns are now skipped with a warning until proper support lands (#400).

### Split Output Files No Longer Packed into the Next Run (#1921, #1920)

With `--split-output`, files like `repomix-output.1.xml` from a previous run are no longer picked up as input.

Special thanks to @lorenzozanee for their first contribution! 🎉

### `--remove-comments` Keeps URLs in CSS, SCSS, Less, Vue and Svelte (#1912, #1965, #1911)

`url(http://example.com/logo.png)` was cut to `url(http:` because `//` was treated as a comment. Each language now uses its own comment rules, and Vue and Svelte files are handled per `<script>`, `<style>` and markup section.

Special thanks to @plox-sumit for their first contribution! 🎉

### Non-ASCII File Names in Git Logs and Diffs (#1940, #1979)

Names like `日本語.txt` no longer appear as `"\346\227\245..."` in git logs and diffs, and `output.git.sortByChanges` now sorts these files correctly.

Special thanks to @feiiiiii5 for their first contribution! 🎉

### `--token-count-tree 0` Shows the Full Tree (#1941)

It printed nothing before; it now shows every file.

Special thanks to @feiiiiii5 for this contribution! 🎉

### Nested `--stdin` Paths on Windows (#1922)

Piping paths such as `src/(routes)/page[1].ts` into `repomix --stdin` on Windows packed only root-level files. Nested paths now match.

Special thanks to @lux-liang for their first contribution! 🎉

### Fatal Errors Visible Under `--quiet` and `--stdout` (#1875, #1874)

A failed pack under `--quiet` or `--stdout` exited with code 1 and printed nothing. The error now goes to stderr.

Special thanks to @sxh313 for this contribution! 🎉

### MCP Server Fixes (#1867, #1866, #1865, #1864, #1869, #1868)

- `--mcp --verbose` no longer writes diagnostics to stdout, where clients read them as protocol frames. (#1867)
- Error logging is no longer silenced for the rest of the session after a `generate_skill` or `pack_remote_repository` call. (#1865)
- `grep_repomix_output` now formats context like `grep -C` and handles very large outputs. (#1869)

Special thanks to @sxh313 for their first contribution! 🎉

## Security Hardening 🔒

### MCP `pack_codebase` Always Runs the Secret Scan (#1960)

A `repomix.config.json` in the packed directory could turn off the secret scan for MCP packs with `security.enableSecurityCheck: false`. The scan now always runs for MCP packs; plain CLI runs still follow the config file.

## Documentation 📚

The MCP docs now state that without `--sandbox`, `pack_codebase` trusts the `repomix.config.*` in the directory it packs, just like running the CLI there. Use `--sandbox` when your assistant may pack untrusted directories, such as cloned third-party repositories. (#1961)

See [MCP Server: Sandbox Mode](https://repomix.com/guide/mcp-server#sandbox-mode) and [Why a config file is code](https://repomix.com/guide/security#why-a-config-file-is-code).

## How to Update

```bash
npm update -g repomix
```
